title: Napa Valley Aloft Hot Air Balloon Rides
specs: Launches from historic Vintage 1870 grounds in Yountville and Kimball Ranch in Pope Valley
Views include Mt. St. Helena, Mayacamas Range, Vaca Range, San Francisco skyline on clear days
Pilots have over 100 years and 20,000 hours combined experience
Minimum age 6 years and at least 48 inches tall to see over basket
Not suitable for pregnant women, infants, recent deep scuba divers, people with chronic pain or recent major surgery
Must be able to stand for entire flight and walk on uneven ground
Must be able to adopt bended knee seated landing position and have upper-body strength and flexibility to climb in and out of basket
Medical doctor’s release required if medical condition could be aggravated

services.name: Tasting
services.desc: Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion or simply seeking a remarkable experience, a hot air balloon flight promises an adventure that combines the thrill of flight. Let us elevate your Napa Valley visit to new heights. Discover Napa Valley like never before with our exclusive Premium Hot Air Balloon Flight package. Soar above the breathtaking landscapes of the wine country, taking in unrivaled views that only a hot air balloon can provide. Your journey begins with a warm greeting of freshly brewed beverages and artisanal pastries, setting the stage for an extraordinary experience. Meeting location Yountville: Begin your adventure in the heart of downtown Yountville at 6525 Washington

services.name: balloon flight
services.desc: Our family comprises a great team, offering you a personal touch and an unforgettable experience on your Napa Valley hot air balloon adventure. Jayson, Jay, Gretchen, and Jared invite you to fly with Napa Valley Aloft Balloon Rides! The Kimball Family ballooning history goes back to the 1970s when Napa Valley was beginning to develop as a destination for wonderful wine and great restaurants. Tourism was on the rise and so were the first hot air balloon Napa companies! Jay Kimball was one of the first pioneers of commercial ballooning in Napa Valley and all will agree that Jay took ballooning to “new heights.” Jay opened up new flight corridors in Lake Tahoe, Del Mar, Ca. and San Miguel de

includes: Equipment inspected regularly at FAA-designated repair stations
blurb: Guests take early morning hot air balloon flights launching mainly from Yountville or Pope Valley. Flights last about 45 minutes to 1 hour, ascending between 1,000 and 3,000 feet with views of Napa Valley, Mt. St. Helena, Mayacamas Range, and sometimes San Francisco skyline. Ballooning is weather dependent and subject to cancellation for safety.
extraNote: Deposit collected at booking, remaining balance charged on day of flight · Flights subject to cancellation due to unsafe weather conditions · Release of Liability and Assumption of Risk Agreement required before flight · Historic grounds of the Vintage 1870 in Yountville or Kimball Ranch in Pope Valley for alternate flights
